subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Like oil and water

options.text: Two people who like each other
Two people who are different from each other
Two people who are similar to each other
Two people who like to work with each other

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Two people who are different from each other '.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'Like oil and water'** is **'Two people who are different from each other'.**
 
• **Like oil and water:** two people who are like oil and water are very different from each other.
 
 
• *Example: He and the General did not get along. The **two were like oil and water** together.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Two people who are different from each other.*
